name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK terrorism threat level raised to Severe: an attack is highly likely
state: The UK national terrorism threat level remains Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after MI5 raised it in October 2026. The MI5 Director General warned on 13 Oct of a rising threat from anti-migrant and anti-Muslim extremism alongside Islamist terrorism. No change as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Stay alert in crowded places and report anything suspicious via gov.uk/ACT or 999 in an emergency. Follow police and MI5 guidance.
